issues.failure_explanation: For SPD A and symmetric positive definite B, cond_2(B^{-1/2} A B^{-1/2}) is the spectral condition number of B^{-1}A, whereas cond_A(BA) is the spectral condition number of BA; they differ in general (e.g. A = diag(2,1), B = diag(1,2): cond_2(B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2}) = 4 but cond_A(BA) = 1). The displayed PCG iteration (p^0 = B r^0, alpha_k = |r^k|_B^2/|p^k|_A^2) and both preconditioners built later (B^SMG, B^AS, which approximate A^{-1} with spectra of BA bounded) correspond to the splitting B^{1/2} A B^{1/2}, for which the correct identity is cond_2(B^{1/2} A B^{1/2}) = cond_A(BA). The derivation instead fixes the splitting B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2} with x = B^{-1/2} x~, r = B^{1/2} r~, p = B^{-1/2} p~, which is consistent only with a preconditioner B^{-1} (B approximating A) and would yield p^0 = B^{-1} r^0, contradicting the displayed iteration; the quoted identity mixes the two conventions.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the splitting A~ = B^{1/2} A B^{1/2}, b~ = B^{1/2} b with x~ = B^{-1/2} x, r = B^{-1/2} r~, p = B^{1/2} p~ and the norm identity with y~ = B^{-1/2} y throughout Section 3.1, replace eq: condition numberfor PCG by cond_2(B^{1/2} A B^{1/2}) = cond_A(BA), and write cond_2((B)^{1/2} A (B)^{1/2}) in the two corollaries. All proofs and substantive claims then stand unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The stated equalities cond_2((B)^{-1/2}A(B)^{-1/2}) = cond_A(BA) in Corollary corollary: symmetric MG optimality and Corollary theorem: AS condition number bound are false as written, and the concluding inference that h- and p-independent boundedness of cond_A(BA) suffices for robust PCG contraction via Theorem theorem: CG convergence is unsupported as written; the prose claims of robust PCG+sMG and PCG+AS contraction (Sections 5-7) inherit this. The actually proved bounds cond_A(B^SMG A) <= (1+q^2)/(1-q^2) and cond_A(B^AS A) <= C/c are unaffected.
issues.title: Inconsistent PCG splitting convention yields a false condition-number identity
issues.why_classification: The repair is a forced, uniform exponent-sign convention correction requiring no new argument or lemma; every substantive guarantee (h- and p-robust PCG contraction, optimality of both preconditioners, AFEM complexity) survives intact, so there is no mathematical loss.

issues.failure_explanation: Finite patch overlap bounds sums of squared local norms, sum_z enorm(w)^2_{omega^n_m(z)} lesssim enorm(w)^2, not sums of local norms: with ~2^{md} generation-m patches and equidistributed energy, sum_z enorm(w)_{omega^n_m(z)} ~ 2^{md/2} enorm(w), so the final lesssim in Step 2 (and the Step-2 target inequality itself) is false by an unbounded mesh-dependent factor. The defect is not repairable by merely inserting squares: the per-patch estimate eq: strengthened CS intermediate only holds with the global enorm(v_k), and even after localizing it to enorm(v_k)_{Omega_z}, the number of generation-m patches intersecting a single level-k element grows like (h_k/h_m)^d = 2^{m-k}, so Cauchy-Schwarz over the patches yields at best delta^{m-k} 2^{(m-k)/2} = 2^{(m-k)(d-1)/(2d)}, which has no decay. Hence the per-patch strategy of the proof cannot deliver the stated estimate edual{v_k}{G^m_{l,1} w_k} lesssim delta^{m-k} enorm(v_k) enorm(w_k) with delta = 2^{-1/(2d)}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the proof of the lemma by a correct argument, e.g. apply the uniform strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz inequality (lem:added-2) to the aggregate G^m_{l,1} w_k on the whole domain and estimate h_m^{-1} ||G w|| via hat-function scaling and sum_z enorm(P_z w)^2 lesssim enorm(w)^2 (this proves the bound but only with a global diffusion-contrast constant), or properly adapt the cited FFPE17 analysis to retain the stated local constant Cloc; the written per-patch summation cannot be salvaged by a local edit.
issues.overall_effect: The strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for the generation-restricted operators G^m_{l,1} is unproven as written; consequently the upper bound in Theorem theorem: AS operator (eq: AS operator bounds), the eigenvalue and condition-number bounds for the additive Schwarz preconditioner in Corollary theorem: AS condition number bound, the asserted h- and p-robust contraction of PCG+AS, and its use in the AFEM discussion (Section 7) are unsupported as written.
issues.title: Summation step in proof of strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for G is false (sum of norms instead of sum of squares)
issues.why_classification: The statement is standard and remains credible, but the given proof's closing strategy fails and a genuinely different, contained argument is required: the elementary aggregate repair weakens the stated local-constant dependence of Theorem theorem: AS operator and of the AS condition-number bound to a global-contrast constant (a limited weakening leaving a recognizably comparable hp-robust optimality result), while the stated local-constant version needs a nontrivial adaptation of external analyses; no headline claim is abandoned, so the issue is not serious.
